Every episode will have multiple paths, achievements, and unlockables, making multiple playthroughs very worthwhile (especially if you wanna get with everybody). Episodes are each full-length visual novels of their own and can be played stand-alone or as the full series.

  • Will there be a long wait between episodes?
    Episodes will come out monthly. The series won't release until all eight episodes are ready, so there won't be any long waits. Plus, a month should give you enough time to play through an episode at least once.

  • Do I have to play through every episode?
    No, you can pick and choose which episodes you want to enjoy. The game will take into account how many episodes you've played, making sure you can still enjoy as much as possible. Some default choices will be used in future episodes. There will be reminders and fill-ins for any important information. Season 2 would likely take about 12-18 months, with the goal of having another 8 episodes ready to go.
